सोत्क,
सोत्कण्ठ a. 
__1 Ardently longing, impatiently eager, anxious; as in सोत्कण्ठमालिङ्गनम्. 
__2 Regretful. 
__3 Bewailing, sorrowing. 
-ण्ठम् ind. 
__1 With ardent or eager longing, anxiously; प्रोड्डीयेव बलाकया सरभसं सोत्कण्ठमालिङ्गितः [[
a. With a wager or bet.

a. 
__1 Excessive. 
__2 Exaggerated. 
__3 Ironical, sarcastic. 
-सः Violent laughter. 
-सः, -सम् Ironical exaggeration, sarcasm, irony; 
-सम् ind. Mockingly; cf. व्याजस्तुति. 
-Comp. 
-हासिन् one who laughs mockingly; तमालोक्य प्रियाकेलिं नले सोत्प्रासहासिनि [[

a. Vigorous, active, energetic, persevering. 
-हम् ind. Actively, energetically, carefully.

a. 
__1 Regretful, repining, anxious, sorrowful. 
__2 Yearning, longing for.
a. Raised, elevated, high, lofty; सोत्सेधैः स्कन्धदेशैः [[
